is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles funestus s.l. and Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) in Misungwi district, Tanzania (page 1, Abstract; page 3, Table 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and L1014S (L995S) in An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis (page 6, text).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 6 states: 'Three hundred and twenty-two field collected An. gambiae s.l. were screened for the presence of L1014F-kdr and L1014S-kdr mutations. At the population level, homozygous L1014S-kdr was present in almost all An. gambiae s.s. individuals (98%; 90/92)... No L1014S-kdr or L1014F-kdr were detected in any An. arabiensis tested (n = 230); L1014F-kdr was not detected in any An. gambiae s.s. individuals.'

african_field_population.evidence: Field-caught adult mosquitoes collected from 86 study clusters in Misungwi district, Lake Zone, North-West Tanzania (pages 1-3, 9-10).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary entomological baseline evaluation before a cluster randomized controlled trial (page 2, 9-10).

sub_country_location.evidence: Misungwi district (latitude 2.85000 S, longitude 33.08333 E), North-West Tanzania, with specific wards named (e.g., Mamaye, Koromije, Bulemeji, Idetemya, Ilujamate, Kanyerere) (pages 5, 6, 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between August 2018 and January 2019 (pages 2, 9).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Baseline entomological surveillance data collected specifically for a 4-arm RCT (NCT03554616) in Misungwi.

supplement.evidence: The genotype numbers for L1014F and L1014S are fully reported in the text of the main paper (page 6).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated vector bionomics, transmission dynamics, and pyrethroid resistance in Misungwi district, Tanzania, between August 2018 and January 2019. Genotyping of 322 field-collected An. gambiae s.l. identified homozygous L1014S (L995S) in 90/92 An. gambiae s.s. (98%) and wild-type alleles in all 230 An. arabiensis, with L1014F (L995F) absent in both species.
